I just don't want a surprise bill in April. Can you confirm what's correct and fix it if needed? My hybrid agreement is HWA-0718, approved by my director in June. I'm also not sure whether my 401k deferral changes when the state changes, and whether I need to update anything for my parking benefit.

payroll_tax_guide.T-1: Withholding follows the states where work is physically performed, unless a reciprocity agreement applies.
payroll_tax_guide.T-2: Easton-Westmark reciprocity: a resident of Westmark who works in Easton is taxed only by Westmark; the employee must file form REC-EW with payroll, after which payroll withholds Westmark tax only.
payroll_tax_guide.T-3: Until a REC-EW form is on file, payroll withholds for each state where work is performed, based on the approved work arrangement.
payroll_tax_guide.T-4: Remote days are sourced to the state of the employee's home address.
payroll_tax_guide.T-5: Employees are responsible for any state tax owed on filing; payroll corrects withholding prospectively once the setup is fixed.
payroll_tax_guide.T-6: Payroll Tax does not give individual tax advice; employees should consult a tax professional about prior-year filings.
payroll_tax_guide.T-7: State changes do not affect 401k deferral percentages or pre-tax commuter benefits.

state.payroll_faq: Reciprocity forms can be filed any time in self-service under Tax > State forms. Changes take effect on the next payroll after processing, and payroll does not refund prior withholding to one state because another state was owed.
state.analyst_note: Setup predates the hybrid agreement. No REC-EW on file. Will reply after checking with the tax lead. - L. Ibarra

court_notice.type: Notice of Chapter 13 Bankruptcy Filing and Automatic Stay
court_notice.text: The filing of the petition operates as an automatic stay of most collection actions against the debtor, including wage garnishments by creditors. The stay does not apply to the collection of domestic support obligations (child support, alimony) through income withholding orders. The trustee may issue a separate wage order directing the employer to pay plan payments to the trustee. Creditors who continue collection after notice of the stay may be sanctioned by the court.

comp_plan.title: FY26 Inside Sales Compensation Plan
comp_plan.D-1: New hires receive a monthly draw against commission for their first three full months.
comp_plan.D-2: The draw is non-recoverable during the first three full months: if commissions earned in a month are less than the draw, the shortfall is not recovered.
comp_plan.D-3: From month four, any draw paid is recoverable: shortfalls carry forward and are deducted from future commissions, never from base salary.
comp_plan.D-4: On separation, any unrecovered recoverable draw balance is forgiven unless the employee resigns within 12 months of hire, in which case it is deducted from final commissions only.
comp_plan.D-5: Draw amounts and months are shown on the monthly commission statement.
comp_plan.D-6: A partial first month (start date after the 1st) is not counted as a full month.
comp_plan.D-7: Statement disputes must be raised with Sales Compensation within 30 days of the statement date.

security_scan_v31.finding: SDK 'adkit-x 3.2' uploads the full contacts list and SMS metadata to collector.adkitx.example.net on first launch without a permission prompt. Classified: Malicious data exfiltration (policy 8.1).
security_scan_v31.action: App removed from sale 2026-08-29; developer notified.

developer_response.text: We were as surprised as you. adkit-x was a third-party ad SDK; the vendor issued advisory AKX-2026-07 saying versions 3.2-3.3 were compromised by an attacker and 3.4 is clean. We updated to 3.4 in build 3.2 and rotated our keys. We have also added an SDK review step to our release checklist. Please reinstate the app; our users are asking where it went.

state.advisory_summary_as_attached: AKX-2026-07: 'Between June 30 and August 20, an attacker inserted code into adkit-x 3.2 and 3.3 builds distributed from our package mirror. Version 3.4, released August 22, is rebuilt from verified sources. Customers should upgrade immediately and review data collected by affected builds.'

security_scan_v32.network: No connections to collector.adkitx.example.net. adkit-x 3.4 contacts ad server ads.adkitx.example.net with advertising ID only. Crashly sends crash logs with device model.
security_scan_v32.permissions: No contacts or SMS permissions requested; none accessed.

malware_policy.8.1: Apps that transmit user data without disclosure and consent are removed. Reinstatement requires a new build that removes the behavior, verified by a clean security scan.
malware_policy.8.2: Developers are responsible for third-party SDKs they include.
malware_policy.8.3: Repeat incidents within 12 months result in account termination.
malware_policy.8.4: Reinstated apps must update their privacy label to disclose all SDK data collection.

state.privacy_label_v32: Collects: advertising ID (used for ads). Not linked to identity.
state.account_history: No prior incidents for this developer account (enrolled 2019).
